decided_by: user 2026-10-03: 'Everything has to be the same' -- one methodology at every team size; no 4v4-only recipe changes
frozen_before: DUAL_BRANCH_R1_4V4_K1 sealed (its result file did not exist; its rows were not read)

change.why: a rung that changes the recipe at one team size would give 4v4 a different method from 2v2 and 6v6. R1 is kept: its rule k = max(1, floor(N/3 + 1/2)) is one formula for every N and leaves the current 2v2 (k=1) and 6v6 (k=2) configurations unchanged.

pass_rule: unchanged from the parent (both Delta lower bounds > 0 at the frozen 98.33% level; 95% reported); with one attempt this is conservative

after_R1.pass: 4v4 adopts R1; 2v2 and 6v6 already follow the same rule; Stage 4 waits for PI review
after_R1.no_pass: STOP and report; nothing starts automatically. Any further change must apply identically to 2v2, 4v4 and 6v6 under its own frozen spec (cross-scale rung), decided by the PI.

reserved_but_unused: the R2/R3 seed blocks stay registered (RESERVED) and unused; they are retired if no cross-scale rung reuses them
